application_review: RoughConjugateLatticeTopology defines the actual conjugate subgroup Gamma.map(conj g), proves its membership formulas, constructs a subgroup homeomorphism and a continuous surjection on right-coset spaces, and transfers discreteness and compactness of the ambient quotient for arbitrary g without normality assumptions.

RoughNativeConjugateLogSpan proves actual adjoint transport from the original rational logarithm span to the conjugated subgroup logarithm span. For v in the original rational logarithm span, the span of exp(v) Gamma exp(-v) equals the original span, using rational adjoint invariance for v and -v and the genuine inverse adjoint identity.

RoughNativeConjugateLatticeCompact transfers rationality of every real Lie subspace along rational conjugation, proves compactness of the original rational subgroup quotient by the actual conjugated lattice intersection, proves intersection discreteness, and specializes to the given character kernel and every integer representative exp(jV).

RoughConjugateOrbitMap constructs the actual map h mod (L intersect g Gamma g inverse) to ell*h*g mod Gamma. It proves well-definedness, injectivity, fixed-factor continuity, joint continuity in ell and the quotient point, and closed embedding when the source quotient is compact and the target Hausdorff.

RoughNativeKernelOrbit discharges compact-source and Hausdorff-target hypotheses for the actual fixed rational character kernel, rational V and every integer j. The induced native kernel orbit map is a closed embedding with compact range in the original lattice quotient.

Compared with Section 06 rough-kernel-test: the subgroup is literally Gamma.map((MulAut.conj sigma).toMonoidHom), namely sigma Gamma sigma inverse. Its pullback along the actual kernel subgroup inclusion is exactly the intersection lattice used in the paper.

Conjugation does not require Gamma normal. Membership equivalence h in conjugate Gamma iff sigma inverse*h*sigma in Gamma is proved explicitly. All quotient constructions use the actual right-coset relation x inverse*y in Gamma, not quotient group multiplication.

The topological statements apply to every conjugating element. The subgroup map is an actual homeomorphism; the ambient quotient map is continuous and onto. These prove discreteness and quotient compactness independently of any rationality claim.

Equality of rational logarithm spans requires v in the original span. Forward inclusion uses the actual adjoint/exponential rationality theorem. Reverse inclusion first applies Ad(exp(-v)) within the original span and then transports by Ad(exp(v)) to the conjugate span. This avoids a circular assumption that -v already belongs to the conjugated span.

Every original rational subspace stays rational because the two specified rational logarithm spans are equal. The existing native rational lattice compactness theorem then applies to the conjugated lattice with its own verified discreteness and ambient quotient compactness.

For sigma_j=exp(jV), original rational membership follows from rational scalar multiplication by the integer j. The compact kernel quotient theorem keeps the same supplied F and uses its original rationality, not a substitute character. No period K or residue-range assumption is needed for this theorem because it holds for every integer j.

The induced map is exactly ell*h*sigma mod Gamma. Its coset relation reduces to sigma inverse*(h1 inverse*h2)*sigma in Gamma. Joint continuity in ell and h follows from the original continuous left action on G/Gamma. Native target Hausdorffness follows from the actual discrete lattice being closed.

Neither continuity on a compact domain nor closed embedding proves Lipschitz continuity. This batch does not claim a smooth or uniform quantitative bound for the induced tests. Smooth descent and uniform derivative/metric comparison remain explicit next obligations.
All retained proof sources and axiom sets are unchanged; these are author-side checks, not independent kernel replay.

StrongConjecture remains unproved; no unavoidable obstruction is established. Rational conjugation now preserves the actual rational logarithm span; conjugated lattices are discrete and cocompact, and their intersections with the specified rational character kernel give compact quotients. The paper orbit/test map is well-defined, injective and jointly continuous, and its native fixed-residue specialization is a closed embedding with compact range. Joint native logarithmic polynomiality and uniform degree bounds were retained. Smoothness and a uniform quantitative Lipschitz bound for induced tests are not proved by continuity or compactness and remain open, along with slow-factor freezing, sampling estimates, assembly of scalar models and affine spatial substitution. The quantitative Leibman obstruction, affine substituted-polynomial coefficient identity, corrected box comparison, stretched-filtration prerequisites, finite density extraction, dimension induction and uniform rough-step comparison remain open. Package finite native readings and connect conditional face laws. Buffered short-bin geometry, prior-event positive probability, extra-conditioning posterior control, quantitative native smooth-observable bounds, conditional face invariance and positive-probability Alignment remain open. HasNativePeriodicIntervalInverse and HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remain explicit unproved existence inputs. Complete final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction.
